worker_output.summary: Implemented espionage system fixes per design/diplomacy/espionage.md. Added §1.3 All Spies Fail catastrophic result: when detection_roll == 100, all of the sender's active spies skip their next turn. Added §6.2 Tech Theft tier-based value modifiers (+10 for Tier 1-3, 0 for 4-6, -5 for 7-9, -10 for 10-12, -15 for 13+). Fixed sabotage_bases base success rate from 20% to 35% per §6.4. Added skipTurns field to SpyMission interface. Fixed test file references to non-existent 'propaganda' mission type.

design_compliance.quote: When any single spy roll hits a catastrophic failure threshold (natural roll of 100 on the detection die), ALL of that empire's currently-infiltrated spies lose their next action turn
Ants: Immune, Chameleons: +30, Mice: +10, Rats: +5, Rabbits: -5, Hermit Crabs: -10
